title: Voucher register rows carry no account (accountId, accountName)
summary: VoucherRegisterLineDTO has only particulars (the other side or party). The Account column on the Voucher Register cannot name or link each row's account; today it shows the filtered account only. Add accountId and accountName per row so the frontend can link to the ledger.

title: Customer Profitability Summary has no report generator
summary: EReportKeyType.CUSTOMER_PROFITABILITY_SUMMARY exists, but no ReportGenerator names it, so POST /api/reports/CUSTOMER_PROFITABILITY_SUMMARY has nothing behind it (it is not in the Swagger run list). The design needs customer, total cost, total revenue and total profit for a date window, with an as-of date and an accounting book. Until then the hub page shows a not-connected notice.

title: A/P and A/R payment history lines carry no document id or type, and omit the bill's own line
summary: Each line has only type, date, docNumber, account, amount, balanceAfter. The design makes Document Number a link, which needs documentId and documentType (BILL_PAYMENT, BILL_CREDIT, VENDOR_PREPAYMENT, PROFORMA_APPLICATION, RECEIPT...) per line. The design also lists the bill or invoice itself as the first line (type Bill, its date and amount); the backend sends only the settlements.

title: Accounts Payable Register has no generator, so no per-bill rows
summary: EReportKeyType.ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE_REGISTER exists without a generator (the receivable side has ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE_REGISTER with one row per invoice). The Accounts Payable Summary design shows one row per bill: date, document number, vendor, type, account, due date, billed, paid, balance. The accounting AP summary answers per vendor only, so those columns stay blank.

title: Engine reports ignore an accounting book filter
summary: The designs for Open Bills, Open Invoices, A/P and A/R Aging, and both payment histories show an Accounting Book select. The Swagger examples for OPEN_BILLS, VENDOR_AGING and AP_PAYMENT_HISTORY_BY_BILL list no accountingBookId, so the frontend does not offer the filter. Confirm whether these generators can take accountingBookId; if so, say so and the select is added.
